# Jet Exclusive Concierge (JEC)

> VIP airport meet and greet, fast track immigration, and executive mobility at Lagos (LOS) and Abuja (ABV), Nigeria.

Jet Exclusive Concierge is a Nigeria-based VVIP airport concierge and protocol service. We meet and assist travellers at Murtala Muhammed International Airport (LOS) in Lagos and Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport (ABV) in Abuja — handling everything from the aircraft door to your front door.

We serve business executives, diaspora Nigerians, diplomats, celebrities, and high-net-worth individuals who require discreet, seamless airport assistance in Nigeria.

## Services
- Airport meet and greet (arrival and departure)
- Fast track immigration and customs clearance
- Baggage handling and porter service
- VIP and VVIP lounge access
- Private airport transfers and in-city rides
- Protocol officer escort through the terminal
- Multilingual guides

## Seasons and Campaigns
- **Mo Dé, Mo Set** — Early booking campaign for Eid and Ojude Oba season (April–June). Beat the May rush with priority driver allocation and stable pricing.
- **Summer 2026** — Executive mobility package for the summer travel season. Early access available.
- **Christmas 2026** — VVIP airport protocol for the festive season. Priority list bookings open July 1, 2026.

## Airports Served
- Lagos — Murtala Muhammed International Airport (LOS)
- Abuja — Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport (ABV)

## Who We Serve
Business executives, diaspora Nigerians returning home, diplomats, celebrities, high-net-worth individuals, families, and anyone who values their time and expects a seamless door-to-door airport experience in Nigeria.
